units: mm; heights are above the nozzle tip, along the filament axis
about: Starting values for [gcode_macro _oams_macro_variables], measured in each toolhead's published CAD (a section through the filament axis) with the OpenAMS toolhead tool. They are starting points: tune them on the printer (the reload test has the last word). Cutter coordinates (pre_cut/cut/post_cut) depend on the printer and are not here.

parameters.retract_length: mm pulled back before the cut, so the tip leaves the melt zone and the cut is made in solid filament. Starting value: top of the heater block + 2.5 mm, rounded up to 0.5 mm.
parameters.extrusion_unload_length: mm pulled back after the cut, so the cut end clears the extruder gears. Starting value: gear nip to blade + 5 mm, rounded up to 1 mm.
parameters.extrusion_reload_length: mm pushed from the gears (where the AMS stops) down to the stub the cut left. Starting value: gear nip to blade, rounded to 0.5 mm.
parameters.hotend_meltzone_compensation: extra mm on the reload to refill what drips out while parked (no silicone plug). Starting value 0.

heights.nip: drive gear axis (where the gears grip the filament)
heights.tube_seat: where the PTFE tube bottoms out at the top of the toolhead

hotends.name: Phaetus Dragon ST (SF) / HF (incl. Phaetus x Voron edition, TriangleLab Dragon)
hotends.mount: Dragon-style: 4x M2.5 screws on a 16 mm circle into the heatsink (Ø22 flange), Ø12 groove neck for a clamp mount (3.7 mm lug + Ø16 collars), V6 nozzle thread (M6x1.0)

variants.bore: ~2 mm all-metal throat, ~3.8 mm heatbreak ID, Ø4.1 PTFE-tube bore in the top collar; 0.1 mm thin-wall heatbreak (vendor)
variants.source: Phaetus Dragon-HF-Wireframes.pdf (62.2 overall, 26.0 fins, Ø22.0/22.3 flange, Ø4.1 top bore); heatbreak top 43.51 / block 5.18-17.34 / heatsink top 45.72 from the FilamATrix SB STEP (given); CAD slice of Phaetus Dragon HF.stp agrees: block 5.3-17.0, heatsink flange top ~45.3 (+-0.5)

Phaetus Dragon-ST-Wireframes.pdf and Dragon ST.stp: identical outer dimensions and block extents as HF (CAD section: block 5.3-17.0); retailer listings 22.3x26x62.2 for both; heatbreak top assumed same as HF (not measured separately)
Phaetus x Voron HF wireframe (Dragon-Hotend-Voron-Edition-HF.pdf): no top collar, 45.5 from heatsink top to tip, 26.0 fins, 18.5 block/sock height, 19.0 x 26.3 block footprint

hotends.name: E3D Revo Voron (RapidChange)
hotends.mount: Revo-style: 4x M3 bolts, rigid 16 mm-ish square/round heatsink mount designed for Stealthburner; nozzle is a Revo heater+nozzle cartridge changed cold

variants.bore: 2.0 mm metal bore from ~37.5 to ~41 mm; Ø4.1 PTFE bore above ~41.3 mm up to the top (about 7.5 mm of PTFE-tube entry)
variants.source: E3D Revo Voron Reference CAD (Printables 713137), horizontal slices every 0.5 mm: overall 48.8 mm; heater core 2.5-14.6 mm (Ø12.9-16.7); heatbreak neck 15-19 mm; heatsink 19.0-48.8 mm

hotends.name: Phaetus Rapido v1 / Rapido Plus (HF, UHF)
hotends.mount: Dragon-style 4x M2.5 on 16 mm circle, Ø12 groove neck, V6 nozzle thread, extended plated-copper block under a silicone shroud

variants.bore: Ti heatbreak; PTFE tube enters top collar
variants.source: Phaetus Rapido HF wireframes.pdf: 70.7 overall, 55.3 heatsink top, 27.3 fin stack (26.0 fins), Ø22.5; block/shroud extents from Rapido Hotend HF.stp component bounding boxes (shroud 3.7-29.6 above the nozzle-tip solid, estimated: copper block sits inside)
Phaetus Rapido UHF wireframes.pdf: 79.2 overall, 63.8 heatsink top (62.5 to fin top), Ø22.5; shroud 4.0-36.8 from Rapido Hotend UHF.stp (estimated)

hotends.name: Phaetus Rapido 2 / 2 Plus / 2F (HF, UHF)
hotends.mount: Rapido-style Dragon pattern (4x M2.5, 16 mm) like v1; orientation of heatsink matters (SB README)

variants.source: No usable drawing (wireframes are .dwg); STEP is an exploded assembly (parts placed far apart), so no top-to-tip could be derived. Component sizes: nozzle solid 14.1 mm long, block solid 23.4 mm long (includes shroud?).
Rapido_2.0_uhf.stp exploded as above; one body 95.8 mm long (heatsink + mounts).

hotends.name: Phaetus Dragon UHF (and UHF Mini)
hotends.mount: Dragon pattern 4x M2.5 on 16 mm, Ø12 groove neck; 22.0 x 24.4 extended block

variants.source: Phaetus Dragon-UHF-Wireframes.pdf: 79.0 overall, 63.6 heatsink top, 27.1 flange+fins (26.0 fins), block 22.0 x 24.4. Block top = heatsink bottom (63.6-27.1=36.5); block bottom ~12.5 read off the drawing at scale (estimated, +-1.5). The "revised version" STEP is 83.2 mm long and inverted, i.e. 4.2 mm longer than the drawing.

hotends.name: Chube Compact (Luke's Laboratory)
hotends.mount: 4x M3 on a 16 mm bolt circle (Dragon pattern, M3), V6 nozzle interface, Ti Chalice heatbreak, 6x16 (or 15/20) mm cartridge + 3x15 mm PT1000, silicone sock plus metal shield

variants.bore: all-metal Ti Chalice heatbreak (bore not published)
variants.source: Fabreeko/West3D listings: 47.2 mm overall incl. nozzle, melt zone 33 mm (read as: top of melt zone 33 mm above tip, same convention as the Chube Air integration drawing where top of meltzone is 42 or 52 mm); block heights not published

hotends.name: Mellow NF-Crazy (Volcano)
hotends.mount: Mosquito-style clamp mount / 2x M3 square nuts; Volcano-size block (slightly more square than Mosquito)

variants.source: no datasheet or STEP found; vendor page not indexed

hotends.name: Phaetus/TriangleLab Dragon Ace (Volcano block)
hotends.mount: Dragon-style frame, extra long Volcano-type ceramic heater block, V6 nozzle

variants.bore: V6 nozzle 0.4 etc.; bore not measured
variants.source: Hotend solid "Dragon_ACE" (TriangleLab mock-up) inside the SB_Printhead_Dragon_ACE STEP: nozzle tip z=-4.4, block z 0.7-21.5, silicone sock -2.4..22.6, heatsink frame 23.6-46.6, top 46.6; all re-referenced to the tip

hotends.name: Bambu Lab X1C/P1 hotend (and TriangleLab CHC clones)
hotends.mount: Bambu clip-in assembly (heater plate + nozzle in a 25 x 15.7 x ~20 housing), no V6 thread

variants.bore: ~1.8 mm metal bore from h~24 to the top, 4.0 mm in the lower section
variants.source: Community model Hotend.STEP (Printables 533213): overall 44.3 mm; nozzle to ~17.8; 25 x 15.7 heater+heatsink housing from 17.8 to ~38; 7.5 x 12 neck above. Boundaries between block and heatsink not resolved

hotends.name: TriangleLab TZ-V6-2.0 / E3D V6 (with V6 nozzles)
hotends.mount: V6 groove mount (Ø16/Ø12 groove, 3.7 mm lug) for the E3D V6; TZ-V6-2.0 is a V6-style groove-mount with a plated-copper Volcano-length block

variants.source: FilamATrix TZ V6 2.0 STEP (Printables 1170130), solid tz-v2-hotend extracted: top 62.3; block 4.0-25.4; nozzle 0-10.7; heatbreak (Ø4 solid) 25.4-42.1; heatsink fins 26.6-45.6; collars to 62.3

variants.bore: 2.0 mm all-metal bore to ~29.5, then 4.2 mm PTFE bore to the top
variants.source: Community E3D V6 assembly (Printables 51963), slices: nozzle 0-5.8 (hex), block 5.8-17.7 (23 x 16), heatsink Ø22.3 from 19.0 to ~46.5, collars Ø16/Ø12/Ø16 to 61.66. The model comes from the E3D drawing, not an E3D CAD release

hotends.name: Phaetus Dragonfly BMO / BMS (6- and 7-fin)
hotends.mount: V6 groove-mount style heatsink with Ø16/Ø12 groove, copper block

variants.bore: PTFE tube 33.0 mm deep from the top, then metal bore
variants.source: Phaetus BMO-Wireframes.pdf: 62.3 overall, 45.6 heatsink top (collar region 16.7), PTFE depth 33.0 (PTFE-lined heatbreak); block 3.5-18.3 read from the drawing at scale (estimated)
BMS-7 fins STEP component bounding boxes: nozzle solid 0-14.1, block 6.7-19.0, heatsink 24.1-52.5, overall 55.1

hotends.name: Slice Engineering Mosquito / Mosquito Magnum+
hotends.mount: Mosquito clamp mount (own interface), PTFE-less all-metal, quick-release nozzle design

variants.bore: 2.15 mm all-metal bore, 4.1 mm top bore
variants.source: Slice STEP mosquito_model_to_publish.STEP slices: overall 47.0; nozzle 0-5.8; block 5.8-18.3 (width 23-27 incl. cartridges); heatbreak/thread 18.5-21.8; heatsink 21.8-47.0 (Slice says 41 mm for Magnum in its comparison table, that figure was not checked)

variants.bore: 3.4 mm bore in the upper body (not fully resolved)
variants.source: Magnum+ LOW-FI STEP slices: overall 66.0 incl. top collar; wide 20-25 mm body 8-37; not resolved further
